note: GRIME region 'San Francisco' — real-data pipeline (DEM→streams→candidates→stream mask (sites confined to ±150 m of mapped OSM/NHD waterways)→region-appropriate real parameters→shipped scoring, math unchanged). Width curve: Bieger et al. 2015 JAWRA Table 3, Pacific Mountain System. Flood: not applicable here (documented fallback). Peninsula streams largely culverted; tidal bay margins — low valid-site count expected

bank_slope_score.source: USGS 3DEP 10 m DEM local gradient; NC lidar source is outside this region

beach_dist_km.source: haversine to region ref: Ocean Beach

channel_width_score.source: Bieger 2015 PMS width curve on DEM drainage area → shipped width curve

cso_density.source: EPA ECHO open CSO/TCS outfall PF coordinates states=CA, Cauchy proximity

ej_index.source: Census ACS C17002+B03002 two-component demographic index, percentile-ranked within region

estuary_dist_km.source: haversine to region ref: San Francisco Bay

flood_q10_cfs.impervious_fallback_reason: StreamCat imperviousness unavailable; the existing regression-input fallback of 0.0% impervious was used and is disclosed here
flood_q10_cfs.source: flood regression not valid here (Peninsula streams largely culverted; tidal bay margins — low...) — NaN, dropped by constant-column handling

flow_velocity_ms.fallback_reason: EROM/DEM continuity input unavailable; shipped 0.5 m/s default used
flow_velocity_ms.source: Manning (region DEM/D8) blended with EROM continuity (shipped M4 logic)

impervious_pct.fallback_reason: NLDI/StreamCat did not return a snap-compatible catchment value; value remains null and is removed by constant-column handling

land_ownership.source: no parcel integration outside NC (statewide layer is NC OneMap) — unknown 0.5

litter_complaint_density.source: no public machine-readable litter/illegal-dumping feed for this region

navigable_dist_m.source: no USACE NWN clip covering state=CA — navigability gate inert

npdes_points.source: EPA ECHO active NPDES outfalls states=CA (types NPD/GPC/NGP; statuses ADC/EFF/EXP), per catchment

population_density.source: Census ACS 2022 B01003 block groups (bbox, multi-county), area-weighted

protected_area_score.source: USGS PAD-US 4.1 USGS feature service; states=CA; shipped designation-weighted proximity curve

road_density_km_km2.source: OSM drive network (osmnx, cached) clipped per catchment

runoff_coeff_C.fallback_reason: source impervious_pct was unavailable; derived value remains null

seasonal_cv.fallback_reason: NHDPlus monthly EROM was unavailable or failed the drainage-area snap guard; value remains null
seasonal_cv.source: CV of NHDPlus EROM monthly flows per COMID

superfund_score.source: EPA DataMap SEMS active sites states=CA (non-archived, georeferenced), shipped 500 m inverse-distance curve

tourism_amenity_density.source: OSM leisure/tourism features per 2 km radius

tri_facility_density.source: EPA DataMap TRI open facilities states=CA (preferred decimal or packed-DMS recovery), per catchment

usgs_mean_q_cfs.fallback_reason: NHDPlus EROM was unavailable or failed the drainage-area snap guard; value remains null

velocity_feasibility.fallback_reason: derived from the shipped 0.5 m/s velocity fallback
velocity_feasibility.source: shipped step curve on the computed velocity

velocity_transport_favorability.fallback_reason: EROM/DEM continuity input unavailable; shipped 0.5 m/s default used
velocity_transport_favorability.source: scored form of flow_velocity_ms inside the Flow family — peaked Gaussian exp(-((v-0.9)/0.6)^2), model.json curves.velocity_transport_favorability; construct: transport/delivery favorability, deliberately distinct from velocity_feasibility (device operability)

water_intake_score.source: no public surface-intake layer wired outside NC (SWAP layer is NC-only)
